$comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored) or run `bun run setup`. place: name shown beside the weather. latitude: -90..90. longitude: -180..180 (one decimal, about 11 km, is enough for a forecast). timeZone: an IANA zone such as Europe/London. haBaseUrl: Home Assistant, e.g. http://ha.example:8123, or empty for none. haToken: a Home Assistant long-lived access token (a secret; keep it out of this file). haEntities: entity ids to subscribe to.
